questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer rec_sum(Integer x)
    if(x <= 1)
        return 1
    End if
    return x + rec_sum(x - 1)
End function rec_sum

Integer res
Set res = rec_sum(4)
Print res
questions.explanation: rec_sum(4) recursively adds 4 + rec_sum(3) until base case x <= 1 returns 1. Total = 10.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer fun(Integer x)
    if(x <= 0)
        return 0
    End if
    if(x EQUALS 1)
        return 2
    End if
    return 2 * fun(x - 1) + 1
End function fun

Integer ans
Set ans = fun(5)
Print ans
questions.explanation: Traced step-by-step: fun(1)=2, fun(2)=2*2+1=5, fun(3)=2*5+1=11... For n=5, fun(5) = 47.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer tree(Integer x)
    if(x <= 1)
        return x
    End if
    return tree(x - 1) + tree(x - 2) + 1
End function tree

Integer ans
Set ans = tree(3)
Print ans
questions.explanation: Base cases: tree(0)=0, tree(1)=1. For x >= 2: tree(x) = tree(x-1) + tree(x-2) + 1. For x=3, answer is 4.
